profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with large databases, using technical and analytical skills to solve problem both independently, as well as part
of a group. Managed technical projects as a technical lead, as well as communicating with clients. Rapid advancement based on consistently strong
performance in the leadership of large enterprise technology projects. An expert at building new and refining existing technology solutions and their
accompanying processes that span the life cycle to deliver value to end users and other stakeholders

Currently seeking an opportunity to join a team with smart, passionate software engineers to make a difference together

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Drove upgrades to LinkedIn’s Geo Services, enhancing scalability and reliability.
- Spearheaded the development of internal tools for taxonomy standardization and classification.
- Built data annotation and evaluation platforms supporting large-scale AI workflows.
- Advanced internal AI agent initiatives to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.description:
- Participate in the roadmap definition for the team, designing and defining processes for - other developers as well as doing code reviews and production releases, also be a mentor to other members
- Troubleshoot and fix stability, scalability, performance issues, cross-browser compatibility, web standards and interoperability
- Rebuild and expand core features and related products for vBulletin3
- Led the program development of web push notification product for Auto forums, built push notifications API, client and part of server features
- Providing production support, timely fixing production problems encountered, performing data fixes, executing batch processes & troubleshooting issues for business users and business analysts
- Working closely with the Product, Community and the Business team to solicit requirements, suggest technical solutions that scaleable and high profermance fits heavily
- Analyze client needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time, cost, and performance constraints

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Independently developed Forum Subscription feature on homepage for forum sites, and improved subscription email system to offer user customized subscription emails, achieved a dynamic ranking of subscription lists based on the popularity of the forums. Increased 20% of engagement from users
- Built plugin to implement that identify and surface thread's top answers after it reaches a certain threshold of users replies, built in support to have it be smart enough for different limitations. Increased 15% of user traffic
- Wrote high quality code, participated in code reviews, designed systems of varying complexity and scope that contributed immensely to Auto Communities, mainly using PHP, Java, JavaScript/jQuery
- Improved desktop, mobile third-party login components
- Expended dev tools for inter-departmental collaboration and batch operation of plugin function adjustment

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: - Developed “us.blu-raydisc.com” which is the main website of the Blu-ray Disc Association.
